title: Wildflower Meadow Coloring Book: Beautiful Botanical Scenes with Bold and Easy Designs for Adults
subtitle: Relaxing Cottagecore Wildflower Gardens, Meadow Paths, and Nature Scenes for Stress Relief
description: Escape into a peaceful wildflower meadow with 50 beautifully designed coloring pages for adults. Each page features a charming cottagecore scene filled with wildflowers, butterflies, bees, garden paths, rustic fences, and cozy meadow picnics. Bold, clean outlines and large open shapes make every page relaxing and easy to color with markers, colored pencils, or gel pens. Perfect for nature lovers and anyone seeking a calming creative escape.
cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy botanical aesthetic, SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A beautiful wildflower meadow scene at golden hour with a rolling hillside covered in blooming poppies, daisies, lavender, black-eyed susans, and cornflowers. A winding dirt path leads through the meadow toward a distant cozy cottage with a thatched roof. Butterflies and bees float among the flowers. A rustic wooden fence runs along one side. Soft warm sunlight bathes the entire scene in golden tones. Dreamy pastel sky with soft clouds. Premium cozy cottagecore aesthetic, vibrant yet soft color palette with warm yellows, soft purples, gentle pinks, and lush greens. DO NOT include any text in the image.
